# BeatMaster

> Professional web app for live music performance: precision metronome, setlist manager, and MPC-style sampler pads — all offline-capable (PWA).

BeatMaster helps musicians run rehearsals and shows with rock-solid tempo, organized setlists, and on-demand samples. Audio uses the Web Audio API for sample-accurate timing. Includes count-in, TTS song announcements, XLSX import/export of setlists, MusicBrainz metadata lookup, and 5 color skins (light/dark).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Main app — metronome, setlist manager, sampler pads, transport footer.
